preconditions.description: The dimensions of the room are within the specified range, and at least one dimension is even.

preconditions.expression: len(current_config) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in current_config)
preconditions.description: The current configuration has the correct dimensions.

preconditions.expression: len(desired_config) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in desired_config)
preconditions.description: The desired configuration has the correct dimensions.

preconditions.expression: all(char in 'LRUD' for row in current_config for char in row)
preconditions.description: All characters in the current configuration are valid tile orientations.

preconditions.expression: all(char in 'LRUD' for row in desired_config for char in row)
preconditions.description: All characters in the desired configuration are valid tile orientations.

postconditions.description: The number of operations is within the specified limit.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= op[0] <= n and 1 <= op[1] <= m for op in operations)
postconditions.description: All operation coordinates are within the room dimensions.
The current configuration matches the desired configuration after applying all operations.
